item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I am not sure about the "anomalous mayday signal." Like, the whole incident is likely anomalous, but what is anomalous about the mayday signal itself?

I agree with the objection about the plane stating intact, because it is said that the damage to the plane is consistent with crashing onto water at high speed.

Here is what I like: This is linked to something like a factory and something will possibly happen when the interior is completely covered, but the article doesn't need to spell it out for us. I'm also curious about what happened to the plane markings, and any other items in the plane. I assume everything was drained of all paints and dyes.

item.content:encoded:
After reading this skip twice, I'm still not sure what it does. I think it might be a painting that grows and incorporates any pigments that are nearby. At least that's what I thought was implied. I'd make the implications more easily understandable. Maybe hint at it a bit more in the description?
Also there was a few too many (unintelligible)'s in the plane log for me.
